My answer is Padma Ratna Tuladhar, a Newar social and political figure, though I'm recalling this from memory and haven't checked it. The team note doesn't match what I remember. Bishweshwar Prasad (B.P.) Koirala was a Nepali Congress leader and prime minister, but I don't recall him ever serving as mayor of Kathmandu, so I'm not changing my answer because of it.
